provenance: Exact four finding objects emitted during application review, preserved from the tool output after the ongoing domain report advanced. This is a consulted-object snapshot, not a reconstruction of the entire former report.

findings.title: Scalar duality-gap equality is not an optimality certificate
findings.statement: RationalDualityGap permits inconsistent fields via its constructor and compute sets is_optimal solely from equality of two scalar objectives. Feasible primal/dual witnesses and the same constrained problem are absent. An inconsistent(1,0,0,True) record is accepted. Equal values can be an arithmetic gap result only; optimality requires separately validated feasibility and weak duality. No concrete workflow accepting this record has yet been found.
findings.limits: No native/provider execution; scoped Python3.14.2 probe with read-vetted modules and inert namespace packages.

findings.title: Replacing candidate or verifier preserves a stale verified receipt
findings.statement: Starting from a bound complete quartet, submit_candidate with a new candidate or bind_verifier with a new verifier returns Ok but retains the old receipt and is_verified flag. is_complete remains true although the receipt no longer binds the current object. These public mutators violate the aggregate consistency claim without requiring direct field mutation; rechecking validate_invariants would reveal the mismatch but the methods do not call it.
findings.limits: Read-vetted Python3.14.2 modules under inert namespace packages; no native or provider execution, and no claim that an external production caller was exercised.

findings.title: Ensemble enforces per-member rather than declared total budget
findings.statement: Header promises <=70B total parameters for all ensemble members; constructor checks each member independently. Two70B members from different lineages are accepted for140B total. NaN also passes both positivity and ceiling comparisons. Lineage cap and parameter metadata remain caller-supplied.
findings.limits: Small synthetic local inputs; no provider, host authority, actual model-size or deployment behavior evaluated.

findings.title: Stage frame binds candidate ID but not selected body or continuation history
findings.statement: StageFrame validates stage4 candidate_id membership among stage2 candidates, but accepts a different candidate body under thatID. A frame can also continue after a prior StageResult.controller_continue=False because that field is not linked to continuation. Synthetic schema control accepts value999 under theID whose stage2 value was1.
findings.limits: Domain/schema controls only. Outer callers may impose stronger binding/effect checks; no host authority, native pipeline or provider execution occurred.
